title: Gaussian Approximation for Two-Fold Cross-Fitted AIPW under Proportional Dense Asymptotics
banked_reason: D0.5.G graded incremental below the field floor; the shared-training covariance concentration proof uses row-dependent Hessian multipliers, leaving the field-tier joint law and studentization unsupported.
gap_reasons: The advertised uniform joint law and honest studentization depend entirely on the covariance-centering theorem, whose load-bearing marked-row lemma is not proved at the stated rate.

Without an additional decoupling expansion, Efron–Stein does not yield vanishing covariance variance, so the general Gaussian approximation, feasible covariance consistency, coverage result, and fixed-penalty fold ordering remain unsupported.
proof_attempt_summary: D0 derived exact conditional Gaussian coefficients and a constant-effect pivot, then attempted uniform covariance concentration through a marked-row cavity argument. The D0.5 referee identified row-dependent Hessian and mean-value multipliers in that argument, so the field-tier joint law, feasible covariance estimate, honest interval, and concentration-dependent fold ordering are unproved. The raw general-referee response recommends a second leave-one-out or resolvent expansion and marks the claim salvageable, while the normalized verdict marks it unsalvageable; an independent validity consult found this root repair untried. The operator's standing below-field rule nevertheless directs a downgraded bank, with reraise_status retry.
tldr: Ordinary two-fold AIPW with shared ridge-logistic and armwise OLS training admits a uniform root-\(n\) bivariate Gaussian approximation centered by the expectation of its exact finite-sample coefficient covariance. A data-only covariance estimator consistently estimates that possibly \(n\)-dependent center and yields uniformly honest studentized intervals. The corrected marked-row proof retains the full unaffected-row vector sum, controls all cross terms by an operator-norm bound, and establishes the required direct--direct, direct--training, and training--training influence estimates without conditional centering. At the balanced null, the cyclic covariance is \(8\kappa/\lambda+O(\lambda^{-2})\), and the same-ridge two-fold versus six-permutation three-fold ranking reverses between \(\kappa=1/20\) and \(\kappa=1/10\) for every sufficiently large fixed finite penalty. No parameter-only fixed-penalty mixed-resolvent limit or open-neighborhood comparison is claimed.
gap: The nearest published theorem analyzes three-fold AIPW with propensity and outcome models trained on distinct folds under pointwise proportional-design assumptions. Ordinary two-fold AIPW trains them together, creating an endogenous cyclic covariance that marginal ridge-logistic state evolution and standard deterministic-vector resolvents do not identify; that theorem supplies neither simultaneous two-fold and three-fold armwise rank margins nor uniform inference over a common compact triangular-array box.
fill: The proposed system yields the full two-fold joint law and a data-only variance estimator uniformly under the corresponding \(P_{n}\), and it evaluates the exactly normalized six-permutation comparator under \(\widetilde P_{n}=P_{n}\otimes R_{3,n}\) to obtain a finite-penalty sign comparison on two nonempty relatively open subsets of a fixed-penalty coordinate slice.
